STAT_DIP_BONNET_SW_ON : Switch to detect the bonnet open
STAT_DIP_BOOT_OPEN_SW_ON : Switch to detect the boot open
STAT_DIP_BOOT_HANDLE_SW_ON : Switch input boot release motor
STAT_DIP_DRV_WIN_UP_SW_ON : Switch input driver window up
STAT_DIP_DRV_WIN_DOWN_SW_ON : Switch input driver window down
STAT_DIP_PASS_WIN_UP_SW_ON : Switch input passenger window up
STAT_DIP_PASS_WIN_DOWN_SW_ON : Switch input passenger window down
STAT_DIP_HT_RR_WIN_SW_ON : Switch input heated rear window
STAT_DIP_AUX_SW_ON : Auxiliary monitor from main ignition switch
STAT_DIP_POLL_SENSE_ON : Pollution sensor input, polluted air 1
STAT_DIP_RR_WASH_PUMP_ON : Switch for rear washer pump active
STAT_DIP_FT_WASH_PUMP_ON : Switch input front washer pump active
STAT_DIP_INERTIA_SENSE_ON : Inertia sensor to detect unusual stop conditions
STAT_DIP_COL_SW_1_ON : Wiper switch 1 to activate front wipers
STAT_DIP_COL_SW_2_ON : Wiper switch 2 to activate front wipers
STAT_DIP_RECIRC_SW_ON : Toggles between recirc and fresh
STAT_DIP_FT_WIPER_PARK_ON : Front wiper at the parked position
STAT_DIP_RR_WIPER_PARK_ON : Rear wiper at the parked position
STAT_DIP_KEY_IN_SW_ON : Switch input to detect key in ignition
STAT_DIP_LH_LATCH_ON : Switch input for left hand door latch
STAT_DIP_RH_LATCH_ON : Switch input for right hand door latch
